## Public Portfolio Safety Gate

Before requesting review, confirm every statement below.

- [ ] The asset describes a real capability, delivery pattern, or buyer decision.
- [ ] All business claims are accurate, current, and supportable.
- [ ] No client data, names, confidential records, live URLs, credentials, access tokens, or raw configurations are included.
- [ ] Any case-study information is anonymised or has documented permission for publication.
- [ ] The content includes a clear, relevant next step for a prospective client where appropriate.
- [ ] The [Public Portfolio Policy](../docs/public-portfolio-policy.md) has been followed.
